scientific_integrity: The characteristic-p invariant-ring proof is uniform. The standalone finite calculations corroborate the formulas but cannot establish the universal result. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Marked infinity point of the tame mu_(r-1) quotient only; r=p^e odd >=5, h>=2, B_0 B_h nonzero and at least one odd-index coefficient nonzero; arbitrary other points, two-point semigroups and larger scalar groups are not treated. Priority is subject to specialized historical literature.
title: The Weierstrass gap staircase of odd-support scalar quotients of additive curves
